name: Primalist: Spirit of Life renders at normalized summon scale 0.4 (#12469)
contract: Spirit of Life (creature 840002), summoned by Primordial Earth (806536 -> Spirits of Life 572853) and Eternally Chosen (802888 -> 572826), uses display 8824 whose CreatureDisplayInfo.dbc Scale is 2.5 on ModelID 141 (Ent.mdx, ~3.43 model units tall at scale 1.0). With creature_template_model.DisplayScale left at 1, each Spirit of Life rendered ~8.58 model units tall. Setting DisplayScale = 0.4 on creature_template_model (840002, Idx 0, CreatureDisplayID 8824) normalizes effective scale to 2.5 * 0.4 = 1.0 (~3.43 units, matching Druid Force of Nature Treant 1964 display 18922 on the same ModelID 141) without altering shared display 8824 or world mob 9601. Expected: casting 572853 summons Spirit of Life 840002 with display 8824 and owned_creature_scale 0.4.

steps.label: SETUP: Spirits of Life summons a Spirit of Life
SETUP: Spirit of Life keeps its captured display 8824
DISCRIMINATING: Spirit of Life renders at DisplayScale 0.4 instead of 1.0
